title: Symmetry and Rigidity Results for the Mean Field Equation and Hawking Mass on $\mathbb{S}^2$
summary: In this paper, we establish symmetry results for solutions of the mean field equation \[ \fracα{2} Δu + e^u - 1 = 0 \] on $ \mathbb{S}^2 $ for $\frac{1}{3}\leq α\leq 1$, under a geometric condition $(\mathcal{H})$ introduced below. The proofs utilize the Sphere Covering Inequality and incorporate topological arguments on $ \mathbb{S}^2 $. These results are further applied to demonstrate a rigidity property of the Hawking mass for stable constant mean curvature (CMC) spheres, addressing a question posed by Robert Bartnik in 2002.
